summary: Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (create validation 4-15/unique names/4-digit PINs, traitor counts round(n/5), GET /api/game does not leak roles of alive players or pins, private PIN 401/404, setup + roundtable turn guards (traitor->traitor 400, self-vote 400, eliminated voter 400, vote for eliminated 400, turn in day phase 400), advance guards, murder/banish/tie/lives/elimination, faithful win, traitor win by numbers, ended state reveals roles, DELETE). Frontend (390x844) full flow PASSED end to end: Welcome -> How to play -> Setup (empty/duplicate validation, PIN sanitising) -> 10-player game -> 10 private setup turns via PIN pad (wrong PIN error shown, traitors excluded from victim list, traitor brief with victim + action) -> Begin Day 1 -> peek mode 'Check my secret' -> Round Table 10 votes (self not in list, traitors confirm murder + pick next victim, 2nd traitor sees 'already confirmed') -> Reveal (intro/murder/banish+tally) -> Begin Day 2 (lives correct: Alice 1, Bob 1). Also verified elimination reveal ('They were... A Traitor'), winner screen, ended card with all roles, Start new game, menu End game confirm sheet (cancel + confirm). Found 1 layout bug on Setup (row overflows screen width) and 1 navigation-stack bug (router.replace('/') stacks duplicate dashboards). No deprecated Expo packages found. Game deleted at end (GET /api/game -> exists:false).

minor.issue: force flag is unauthenticated; anyone can skip setup/votes. Acceptable for family game but UI never uses it.
No rate limit on 4-digit PIN; brute-forceable (10k combos). Low risk for family use.

If tomorrow's chosen victim is eliminated at the same reveal (e.g. banished to 0 lives), target becomes None and there is simply no murder that day; traitors get no chance to re-pick (TraitorBrief shows 'No murder is planned right now'). Consider letting traitors pick a replacement (e.g. via a private turn in day phase).

ui_bugs.issue: Row overflows the screen at 390px width: name input is 266px wide (RN-web TextInput intrinsic width ignores flex:1), PIN input right edge at x=399 and remove button at x=407-439 are off-screen (cut off / untappable). Worse on 375px. Fix: add minWidth: 0 (or width: 0) alongside flex:1 on the name TextInput style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/setup.tsx:84 and styles.input/row at :143-156

integration_issues.issue: setup.tsx:30 and reveal.tsx:25/66 call router.replace('/') from a screen pushed on top of index, so the stack becomes [index, index] and grows by one dashboard every day (confirmed: 2 'dashboard-screen' elements in DOM after setup). Android back / swipe-back reveals stale dashboards. Use router.back() or router.dismissTo('/') (or dismissAll) instead.

issues: Backdrop shows visible hard horizontal bands (around y~175 and y~630 at 390x844) between image/gradient areas - looks like a rendering seam rather than an intended fade.

action_items: Fix Setup row overflow: add minWidth: 0 to name TextInput (flex:1) in /app/frontend/app/setup.tsx so PIN + remove button fit at 375-390px
Replace router.replace('/') in setup.tsx:30 and reveal.tsx:25,66 with router.back()/router.dismissTo('/') to avoid stacking duplicate dashboards each day
Optional: handle case where tomorrow's victim is eliminated at reveal (let traitors re-pick) - currently day silently has no murder
Optional: smooth the reveal backdrop seams
critical_code_review_comments: Privacy model is sound: public state only exposes roles at 0 lives or ended; tally exposes counts only, not who voted for whom.
Pytest must be run with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist) because tests share the single global 'current' game.
player/[id].tsx uses router.back(); on a deep-link/reload of /player/:id there is no history to go back to (web only).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; setup row layout overflow)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test games created and deleted; final state GET /api/game -> {exists:false}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single global game. Run backend tests: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_traitors_game.py -n 0. In Playwright use ':visible' with data-testid selectors because duplicate dashboard screens remain mounted in the stack. reveal-eliminated has an 800ms FadeIn delay - wait ~2.5s before asserting.
rca_of_issue: Setup overflow: react-native-web TextInput has an intrinsic min-content width (~266px) so flex:1 cannot shrink it without minWidth:0. Duplicate dashboards: router.replace on a pushed screen replaces only the top entry, leaving the original index beneath.
